description: ensurePublishRepo()'s initial clone has no `--depth`/`--single-branch`/`--filter` limiting flag, so any fresh setup fetches the FULL history of every branch of the entire `anicca` mother repo merely to publish a small side orphan branch. Non-blocking on its own (the task description's own framing), but combined with FIND-002's reachable 'publishRepoDir loss' trigger, a full re-clone can happen more often than a true one-time setup, each time paying for a full-history fetch of the whole mother repo.
